notes.title: Major update still in development
notes.content:
A big update for Pixel Killers - The Showdown is still in development. Major updates will be support for keyboard and mouse, and the inclusion of a tool that will automatically set up port forwarding (this is something that most games that are online playable do, and soon this will also be possible for 
Pixel Killers - The Showdown). I have been working on and off on Pixel Killers - The Showdown but it will now receive full attention until this update is done.

notes.content: Fixed an error when un-joining a local game. US server online. Working on an update that will make hosting a game much easier with no port-forwarding needed.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30525631/c35ca1b73217e6b718359914adc614dbc6ae212c.png[/img]

notes.title: P2P Update
notes.content: A new update introducing P2P connections for less lag when updating player positions is now online.

tags.feature: A new update introducing P2P connections for less lag when updating player positions is now online.

notes.title: Major update available
notes.content: A new major update is now available. The most significant change is the new visible projectiles, of a minor note there should be better support for unstable internet connections when playing online. Only 1 beta server is online at the moment for online play, feel free to host a game yourself. You can check if your ports are open with an included feature when setting up a game.

notes.title: Version 1.1 BETA 20 with hotfix
notes.content: The new version contains an important hotfix for the Warehouse Front map where you could not pass through the large doors after they had been destroyed, along with some other minor fixes.
